supersedes: S12 v01 implementation check only; scientific estimand, model, observers, population, random planes, strengths, repeat set, and bootstrap remain unchanged

user_authorization.scope: complete S12 packet through parity, intervention, raw-output seal, frozen bootstrap, independent replay, final result seal, and stop
user_authorization.endpoint: fixed observer augmented task system only

claim_scope.positive_result: selective causal dependence of the frozen LFM plus observer system under the specified activation intervention
does_not_establish: generalization beyond the fixed model, observer bank, panel, and intervention
claim_scope.population_status: paired mechanistic follow-up on the already revealed S11 panel; not independent confirmation

population.input_reuse: sealed S11 token IDs only; no retokenization or corpus edits

terminal_s11_context.interpretation: baseline dynamic range context only; not a new pass threshold

intervention.source_tap: post-block hidden state H_l matching S09 hidden_states[l]

summary.M: float32 mean over all model-visible positions

intervention.center: sealed source observer scaler_mean, stored as FP64
intervention.plane: rank-2 row span of frozen effective pair normals (W_a-W_b)/scaler_scale
intervention.projection: Pq = U.T @ (U @ q), q = summary - center
intervention.M_operator: subtract the same delta from every visible position; tensor Frobenius norm = sqrt(T)*norm(delta); minimum-Frobenius edit for the contracted mean shift
intervention.F_operator: subtract delta from the final visible position only; tensor Frobenius norm = norm(delta)
intervention.random_plane_generation: independent NumPy PCG64 Gaussian 2048x2 QR planes from fixed hash-derived seeds; no target-plane orthogonalization
intervention.random_delta: zero if target delta norm is zero; otherwise norm(target_delta)*random_projection/norm(random_projection)
intervention.random_projection_fail_threshold: norm(random_projection) <= 1e-12 * max(norm(q),1) when target delta is nonzero is fail-closed
intervention.input_batching: one source event per base forward; intervention branches batch only variants derived from that single event and all retain the identical exact sequence length; no padding and no mixed lengths
intervention.tensor_energy_rule: target versus random control contrasts are valid within a layer/surface site; raw M-versus-F intervention magnitudes are not ranked because M broadcasts across T positions and F edits one position
intervention.repeat_check: repeat all nonzero branches for 30 prospectively selected quartets (10 per exact-target class; 120 rows); branch logits and manipulation records must match byte-for-byte

execution_order: verify S09/S11 parent entries and S12 bundle hashes
verify source pair normals span the six sealed target planes and reconstruct all 48 random planes from their frozen seed labels
independently verify and reuse the sealed v01 all-row base/suffix parity and baseline replay receipts; no model feature re-extraction
load pinned frozen LFM and verify pre-run parameter identity
confirm v02 runtime/model identity matches the v01 gate parents
run all six sites, three nonzero strengths, target and eight random arms; emit both terminal observer logits
repeat all nonzero branches on the frozen 30-quartet subset
verify post-run model state is unchanged
seal raw logits, plane-specific manipulation checks, execution receipts, and output tree
analyze labels and compute frozen metrics and shared whole-quartet bootstrap
independently replay the analysis and verify all hashes

analysis.primary_endpoint: frozen-observer probe logit margin: true-target class logit minus best rival class logit
analysis.primary_contrast: mean across 8 random-control target margins minus target-plane target margin at lambda=1; positive means selective target-plane damage
analysis.stratification: independent within exact-target classes 0,1,2 at sealed observed counts
analysis.simultaneous_interval: 95% max-absolute standardized deviation across the six primary contrasts, NumPy linear quantile
analysis.bootstrap_standard_error: sample standard deviation of the 10000 bootstrap estimates with ddof=1
analysis.standardized_deviation: (bootstrap estimate - point estimate) / site bootstrap standard error
analysis.simultaneous_statistic: for each replicate, maximum absolute standardized deviation across all six sites
analysis.interval_formula: point estimate +/- critical quantile * site bootstrap standard error
analysis.site_interpretation_rule: selective causal dependence supported for a site only when its simultaneous lower interval bound is greater than zero; report every site; no all-sites gate
secondary: accuracy, balanced accuracy, class recall, confusion matrix
probe softmax probabilities, predictions, target margins, all pair margins
quartet variant and target class summaries

invariants.v01_correction_reason: The v01 checker incorrectly applied the target-plane residual identity to random-control arms. At row 0, L04-M, lambda=1, random control 1, that identity failed because the control direction is intentionally a different plane. No row was committed and no label or outcome analysis was opened.
invariants.v01_failed_attempt: preserved unchanged at run-v01; its all-row base/suffix parity and S11 class-prediction replay passed, while the first intervention stopped before row commit
invariants.v02_reused_inputs: S11 panel, tokenizer rows, model, observer states, target and random planes, strengths, repeat set, and bootstrap plan are identical to the sealed v01 inputs
invariants.base_terminal_feature_parity: byte-identical to sealed S11 layer-16 M/F cache for every row
invariants.parent_probability_reference: S11 did not store probabilities; S12 computes them from the sealed S11 feature rows and probe states
invariants.baseline_metrics: exact support, prediction counts, accuracy, balanced accuracy, and class recall reproduction after analysis opens labels
invariants.deterministic_repeat: byte identity on all planned repeat rows and branches

forbidden: native LFM answer generation or native candidate scoring
new feature view, representation, model revision, layer, or observer
changing random planes, strengths, layers, or bootstrap after execution begins
selecting controls or examples based on outcomes
FAS-00 inputs, labels, or evaluation data
SAE, neurons, heads, attention patching, or adaptive mechanisms
